# contentful_webhook_signing_secret (Resource)

Manages the Contentful Webhook Signing Secret for a space. Creating this resource replaces any existing secret. Destroying it deletes the current secret, including one rotated outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_webhook_signing_secret" "this" {
  space_id = var.contentful_space_id
  value    = var.webhook_signing_secret
}
```

A replacement in the same space with `create_before_destroy` can delete the newly written secret. See [ownership and recovery](../guides/secrets-and-state#importing-signing-secrets) before replacing the resource or retrying a failed write.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) ID of the space for which the signing secret is created. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Symmetric key shared between Contentful and webhook receivers in the space. Must be exactly 64 characters matching `^[0-9a-zA-Z+/=_-]+$`. Stored in Terraform state. Refresh cannot detect external rotation. Import leaves `value` null; applying the configured value can rotate the secret. Timeout-only updates preserve the secret and stored value. See [importing signing secrets](../guides/secrets-and-state#importing-signing-secrets).

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier, equal to `space_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.
- `delete` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `read` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `update` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.

## Import

~> Import leaves `value` null. Applying the configured value can replace the remote secret, including during a configuration-driven import. See [importing signing secrets](../guides/secrets-and-state#importing-signing-secrets).

### By identity (Terraform 1.12 or later)

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    space_id = var.contentful_space_id
  }
  to = contentful_webhook_signing_secret.this
}
```

### By ID (Terraform 1.5 or later)

```terraform
import {
  id = var.contentful_space_id
  to = contentful_webhook_signing_secret.this
}
```

### From the command line

```shell
terraform import contentful_webhook_signing_secret.this "${CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID}"
```
